purpose: Signs users in and keeps their sessions alive.
gotcha: A session ends after fifteen minutes without activity, so long forms must save drafts.

purpose: Charges payment cards and emails receipts for every purchase.
gotcha: Amounts are stored as integer cents; a failed charge is retried twice before the account is flagged.

purpose: Sends emails and push messages to learners, such as reminders before deadlines.
gotcha: Messages are queued and sent in batches every five minutes, never inline with a request.

purpose: Finds courses and lessons by keyword for the catalogue page.
gotcha: The index is rebuilt nightly, so a lesson published today may not appear until tomorrow.

purpose: Accepts files from teachers and stores them in object storage.
gotcha: Files above fifty megabytes are rejected; virus scanning happens after the upload finishes.

purpose: Runs recurring background jobs on a timetable.
gotcha: Jobs must be idempotent because a crash can cause the same job to run twice.

purpose: Collects usage events to show how learners progress.
gotcha: Events arrive out of order, so dashboards are only consistent after a one hour delay.

purpose: Builds tests for students out of a bank of questions and presents them in order.
gotcha: Question order is shuffled per attempt but fixed once an attempt has started.

purpose: Turns raw scores into letter marks and percentages for report cards.
gotcha: Rounding happens only once at the end, never between intermediate steps.

purpose: Produces progress summaries for parents and school leaders.
gotcha: Reports are generated from a snapshot taken at midnight, not live data.

purpose: Stores profiles, roles, and contact details of everyone on the platform.
gotcha: Email addresses are unique after lowercasing; deleting a user anonymises rather than removes rows.

purpose: Defines courses, units, and the lessons inside them.
gotcha: A published course cannot be edited in place; changes go into a new draft version.

purpose: Records which students belong to which classes and when they joined.
gotcha: Withdrawing a student keeps their history but hides them from rosters.

purpose: Lets teachers and parents exchange direct messages inside the app.
gotcha: Messages are retained for one year and cannot be edited after sending.

purpose: Decides who may open or change a given page or record.
gotcha: Checks are deny by default; a missing rule means access is refused.

purpose: Writes a permanent trail of sensitive actions for compliance reviews.
gotcha: Entries are append only and must never be updated or deleted by application code.

purpose: Creates bulk downloads of data as spreadsheets for administrators.
gotcha: Large exports run in the background and the user is emailed a link that expires in a day.

purpose: Loads rosters and question banks from uploaded spreadsheets.
gotcha: Rows are validated first; one bad row rejects the whole file so nothing is half imported.

purpose: Keeps results of expensive calculations in memory so they are not repeated.
gotcha: Entries expire after ten minutes and are not shared between server instances.

purpose: Calls partner systems when something changes, such as a finished course.
gotcha: Delivery is retried with growing delays when the partner endpoint is down, up to a day.
